prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-16.8s) - Narration: "What exactly is an Arithmetic Progression..."
title = Text("Arithmetic Progression (AP)", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
definition = Text("A sequence where each term is obtained by", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.8)
definition2 = Text("adding a fixed number to the previous term", font_size=32).next_to(definition, DOWN, buff=0.3)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(definition), run_time=2.5)
self.play(Write(definition2), run_time=2.5)

example = MathTex("2, 5, 8, 11, 14, ...").scale(1.2).next_to(definition2, DOWN, buff=0.8)
self.play(Write(example), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.8)  # Complete 16.8s segment

# Segment 2 (16.8-39.6s) - Narration: "This fixed number is the heart of the AP..."
common_diff = Text("Common Difference (d)", color=YELLOW, font_size=36).next_to(example, DOWN, buff=1)
d_formula = MathTex("d = a_{n+1} - a_n", color=YELLOW).next_to(common_diff, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(common_diff), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(d_formula), run_time=2)

# Show different types of APs
pos_ap = MathTex("2, 5, 8, 11, 14, ...", "\\quad d = +3").set_color_by_tex("d", GREEN)
neg_ap = MathTex("10, 7, 4, 1, -2, ...", "\\quad d = -3").set_color_by_tex("d", RED)
zero_ap = MathTex("4, 4, 4, 4, 4, ...", "\\quad d = 0").set_color_by_tex("d", BLUE)

ap_group = VGroup(pos_ap, neg_ap, zero_ap).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(d_formula, DOWN, buff=0.8)

self.play(Write(pos_ap), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(neg_ap), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(zero_ap), run_time=2)
self.wait(12.9)  # Complete 22.9s segment

# Segment 3 (39.6-58.9s) - Narration: "Let's visualize this..."
self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(common_diff, d_formula, ap_group)), run_time=1.5)

general_form = MathTex(
    "a,", "\\quad", 
    "a+d,", "\\quad",
    "a+2d,", "\\quad", 
    "a+3d,", "\\quad",
    "a+4d,", "\\quad ..."
).scale(1.2).next_to(example, DOWN, buff=1.5)

self.play(Write(general_form[0:2]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(general_form[2:4]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(general_form[4:6]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(general_form[6:8]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(general_form[8:]), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.8)  # Complete 19.3s segment

# Segment 4 (58.9-74.1s) - Narration: "To find the common difference..."
diff_example = MathTex(
    "d = (a+d) - a", "\\quad \\text{or} \\quad",
    "d = (a+2d) - (a+d)"
).next_to(general_form, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(diff_example), run_time=3)

highlight_box = SurroundingRectangle(diff_example, color=YELLOW)
self.play(Create(highlight_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.2)  # Complete 15.2s segment

section_title: The N-th Term of an AP
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-14.7s) - How to find any term without listing all?
title = Text("Finding the nth Term of an AP", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
question = Text("How to find the 50th term without listing all numbers?", 
                font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)

dots = VGroup(*[MathTex(r"\cdots") for _ in range(3)])
dots.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.7).next_to(question, DOWN, buff=1)

q_mark = Text("?", font_size=72, color=YELLOW)
q_mark.next_to(dots[1], UP, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(question), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(dots), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(q_mark), run_time=1)
self.wait(7.7)  # Complete 14.7s

# Segment 2 (14.7-39.6s) - Formula explanation
formula = MathTex(r"a_n = a + (n-1)d", font_size=48)
formula.next_to(dots, DOWN, buff=1.5)

labels = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"a:", r"\text{ first term}"),
    MathTex(r"d:", r"\text{ common difference}"),
    MathTex(r"n:", r"\text{ position of term}"),
)
labels.arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.5)
labels.next_to(formula, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(
    FadeOut(q_mark),
    Write(formula),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Write(labels[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(labels[1]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(labels[2]), run_time=2)
self.wait(15.9)  # Complete 24.9s

# Segment 3 (39.6-53.3s) - Explaining (n-1) jumps
jump_arrow = Arrow(LEFT*3, RIGHT*3, color=YELLOW)
jump_arrow.next_to(formula, UP, buff=0.7)
jump_text = Text("(n-1) jumps of size d", font_size=32, color=YELLOW)
jump_text.next_to(jump_arrow, UP, buff=0.2)

self.play(
    GrowArrow(jump_arrow),
    Write(jump_text),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Indicate(formula.get_part_by_tex("(n-1)")),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(8.7)  # Complete 13.7s

# Segment 4 (53.3-69.6s) - Formula from the end
last_formula = MathTex(r"a_n = l - (n-1)d", font_size=48)
last_formula.next_to(labels, DOWN, buff=1)
last_label = MathTex(r"l:", r"\text{ last term}")
last_label.next_to(last_formula, DOWN, buff=0.5)
last_label.align_to(labels[0], LEFT)

self.play(
    Write(last_formula),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Write(last_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(11.2)  # Complete 16.2s

# Segment 1 (0-15.7s) - Narration: "Let's apply this formula to an example..."
title = Text("Finding the 10th Term of an AP", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
sequence = MathTex("2, 7, 12, \\dots").scale(1.2)
sequence.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)

variables = VGroup(
    MathTex("a = 2", color=BLUE),
    MathTex("d = ?"),
    MathTex("n = 10", color=GREEN)
).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1)
variables.next_to(sequence, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.wait(1)
self.play(Write(sequence), run_time=2)
self.wait(1)
self.play(FadeIn(variables[0]), run_time=1.5)
self.wait(8.2)  # Complete 15.7s segment

# Segment 2 (15.7-31.5s) - Narration: "To find the common difference 'd'..."
d_calc = MathTex("d = 7 - 2 = 5", color=RED)
d_calc.next_to(variables, DOWN, buff=1)

# Update d in variables
new_d = MathTex("d = 5", color=RED)
new_d.move_to(variables[1])

self.play(Write(d_calc), run_time=2.5)
self.wait(2)
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(variables[1], new_d),
    run_time=1.5
)
self.play(
    Indicate(variables[2], color=GREEN),
    run_time=1.5
)
self.wait(8.2)  # Complete 15.7s segment

# Segment 3 (31.5-53.8s) - Narration: "Now, we plug these values..."
formula = MathTex(
    "a_{10}", "=", "2", "+", "(10 - 1)", "\\times", "5",
    color=WHITE
).scale(1.2)
formula.next_to(d_calc, DOWN, buff=1)

simplified = MathTex(
    "a_{10}", "=", "2", "+", "9", "\\times", "5",
    color=WHITE
).scale(1.2)
simplified.move_to(formula)

final = MathTex(
    "a_{10}", "=", "2", "+", "45", "=", "47",
    color=YELLOW
).scale(1.2)
final.move_to(formula)

self.play(Write(formula), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(ReplacementTransform(formula, simplified), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(ReplacementTransform(simplified, final), run_time=2)
self.play(
    Circumscribe(final, color=YELLOW, run_time=1.5),
    final.animate.scale(1.2)
)
self.wait(9.8)  # Complete 22.3s segment

section_title: Sum of First n Terms of an AP
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-23.4s) - What if we need to add up terms of an AP?
title = Text("Sum of First n Terms of an AP", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
question = Text("How do we add these numbers?", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)

# Create sample AP terms
terms = VGroup()
for i in range(6):
    term = MathTex(f"{1 + 3*i}")
    terms.add(term)
terms.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.7)
terms.next_to(question, DOWN, buff=1)

plus_signs = VGroup()
for i in range(5):
    plus = MathTex("+")
    plus.move_to((terms[i].get_right() + terms[i+1].get_left())/2)
    plus_signs.add(plus)

dots = MathTex(r"\cdots").next_to(terms[-1], RIGHT, buff=0.4)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(question), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(terms[0]), run_time=1)
self.play(
    *[Write(plus_signs[i]) for i in range(5)],
    *[Write(terms[i+1]) for i in range(5)],
    Write(dots),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(10.4)

# Segment 2 (23.4-41.1s) - Main formula explanation
formula = MathTex(
    r"S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n-1)d]"
).scale(1.2)
formula.next_to(terms, DOWN, buff=1.5)

labels = VGroup(
    Text("n = number of terms", font_size=24),
    Text("a = first term", font_size=24),
    Text("d = common difference", font_size=24)
)
labels.arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
labels.next_to(formula, DOWN, buff=0.8)

self.play(Write(formula), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(labels[0]), run_time=1)
self.wait(1)
self.play(Write(labels[1]), run_time=1)
self.wait(1)
self.play(Write(labels[2]), run_time=1)
self.wait(8.8)

# Segment 3 (41.1-61.4s) - Alternative formula with last term
alt_formula = MathTex(
    r"S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a + l)"
).scale(1.2)
alt_formula.next_to(labels, DOWN, buff=1)

last_term_label = Text("l = last term", font_size=24)
last_term_label.next_to(alt_formula, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(alt_formula), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(last_term_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(13.3)

# Segment 4 (61.4-76.2s) - Connecting the formulas
connecting_arrow = Arrow(formula.get_bottom(), alt_formula.get_top(), buff=0.2)
connection_text = Text("Simplified form", font_size=24)
connection_text.next_to(connecting_arrow, RIGHT)

self.play(
    Create(connecting_arrow),
    Write(connection_text),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(11.7)

section_title: Example: Sum of the First 22 Terms
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-18.8s) - Narration: "Let's work through an example..."
title = Text("Sum of First 22 Terms of an AP", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
problem = MathTex("8, 3, -2, ...", font_size=48).shift(UP)
a_label = MathTex("a = 8", font_size=44).shift(DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(problem), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(
    problem.animate.set_color_by_tex("8", YELLOW),
    run_time=1
)
self.play(Write(a_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(9.8)  # Complete 18.8s segment

# Segment 2 (18.8-34.5s) - Narration: "The common difference 'd' is..."
d_calc = MathTex("d = 3 - 8 = -5", font_size=44).next_to(a_label, DOWN)
n_label = MathTex("n = 22", font_size=44).next_to(d_calc, DOWN)
formula = MathTex(r"S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n-1)d]", font_size=44).shift(RIGHT * 3)

self.play(Write(d_calc), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(n_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(formula), run_time=2.5)
self.wait(5.2)  # Complete 15.7s segment

# Segment 3 (34.5-49.2s) - Narration: "Substituting our values..."
substitution1 = MathTex(
    r"S_{22} = \frac{22}{2}[2(8) + (22-1)(-5)]",
    font_size=40
).shift(UP * 0.5)
substitution2 = MathTex(
    r"= 11[16 + 21(-5)]",
    font_size=40
).next_to(substitution1, DOWN)
substitution3 = MathTex(
    r"= 11[16 - 105]",
    font_size=40
).next_to(substitution2, DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(problem, a_label, d_calc, n_label, formula),
    Write(substitution1),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(substitution2), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(substitution3), run_time=2)
self.wait(3.7)  # Complete 14.7s segment

# Segment 4 (49.2-57.9s) - Narration: "Finally, 11 times -89..."
final_result = MathTex(
    r"= 11(-89) = -979",
    font_size=44,
    color=YELLOW
).next_to(substitution3, DOWN)
box = SurroundingRectangle(final_result, color=YELLOW)

self.play(Write(final_result), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(box), run_time=1)
self.wait(5.6)  # Complete 8.6s segment

# Segment 1 (0-29.9s) - Spiral of semicircles
# Setup axes and points A, B
axes = Axes(x_range=[-5, 5], y_range=[-5, 5])
point_a = Dot([-1, 0, 0], color=RED)
point_b = Dot([1, 0, 0], color=BLUE)
labels = VGroup(
    Text("A", font_size=24).next_to(point_a, DOWN),
    Text("B", font_size=24).next_to(point_b, DOWN)
)

self.play(
    Create(axes),
    Create(point_a),
    Create(point_b),
    Write(labels),
    run_time=3
)

# Create spiral with 13 semicircles
spiral = VGroup()
centers = [point_a, point_b] * 7  # Alternating centers
radii = [0.5 * (i+1) for i in range(13)]  # 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, ...

for i in range(13):
    center = centers[i].get_center()
    radius = radii[i]
    arc = Arc(
        radius=radius,
        angle=PI,
        arc_center=center,
        start_angle=PI if i%2 else 0,
        color=YELLOW
    )
    spiral.add(arc)

# Show formula for semicircle lengths
formula = MathTex(r"\text{Lengths: }\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi, \frac{3\pi}{2}, ...", font_size=36)
formula.to_edge(UP)

self.play(Create(spiral, run_time=15))
self.play(Write(formula, run_time=3))
self.wait(8.9)  # Complete 29.9s segment

# Segment 2 (29.9-51.3s) - Log stack visualization
self.play(FadeOut(spiral), FadeOut(formula), FadeOut(axes), 
          FadeOut(point_a), FadeOut(point_b), FadeOut(labels))

# Create log stack visualization
logs = VGroup()
rows = []
y_pos = -3  # Start from bottom
for i in range(20, 0, -1):
    row = VGroup(*[
        Rectangle(height=0.3, width=0.5, color=BROWN)
        for _ in range(i)
    ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
    row.move_to([0, y_pos, 0])
    rows.append(row)
    logs.add(row)
    y_pos += 0.35

# Show log stack with formula
stack_formula = MathTex(r"a=20, d=-1", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)

self.play(Create(logs, run_time=12))
self.play(Write(stack_formula, run_time=3))
self.wait(6.3)  # Complete 21.3s segment

# Segment 3 (51.3-74.1s) - Potato race
self.play(FadeOut(logs), FadeOut(stack_formula))

# Create race track visualization
track = Line([-4, 0, 0], [4, 0, 0], color=WHITE)
bucket = Square(side_length=0.5, color=BLUE).move_to([-4, 0, 0])
potatoes = VGroup(*[
    Circle(radius=0.1, color=BROWN, fill_opacity=1)
    for _ in range(10)
]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.6)
potatoes.next_to(track, UP, buff=0)
potatoes.shift(RIGHT * 1)  # Offset from bucket

# Add runner path visualization
paths = VGroup()
runner_start = bucket.get_center()
for potato in potatoes:
    path = VGroup(
        Line(runner_start, potato.get_center(), color=RED),
        Line(potato.get_center(), runner_start, color=RED)
    )
    paths.add(path)

self.play(Create(track), Create(bucket), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(potatoes), run_time=3)

# Show paths one by one
for path in paths:
    self.play(Create(path), run_time=1)

self.wait(5.9)  # Complete 22.9s segment
